summary.text: James Bronke, a Green Party candidate, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 5th District to Tim Walberg.
An engineer by profession, he advanced from the Green Party convention on April 25, 2026.

paragraphs.text: James Bronke was born in Manchester, Connecticut, and earned a high school diploma from George J. Penney High School.
He earned a bachelor's degree from California State University, Northridge, in 1982.
Bronke works as an engineer and has been associated with the Eagles Club.
He received 0.4% of the vote to Tim Walberg's 59.1%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
